title: Shared Dressings and Consolidated Shipping Across a Customer's Wound Care Supply Program Enrollments
content:
# Dressings for several wounds — Wound Care Supply Program

Fulfillment coordination note for customers who hold wound care programs for more than one wound.

## Clauses

1. **Counted wound by wound.** Each wound's dressings are counted on that wound's own program.
2. **One dressing over two wounds.** When one dressing covers two adjacent wounds, the dressings are supplied on only one of the two programs — the one with the earlier enrolled date — and the other program receives none of that item.
3. **Consolidated shipping.** Refills for a customer's several wounds whose earliest permitted ship dates fall within the shipment consolidation span, in calendar days, of each other ship together on the latest of those dates.

## Shared dressing (hypothetical)

Two adjacent wounds are each on their own program: program A enrolled 2026-01-12 and program B enrolled 2026-02-03. One dressing item covers both wounds. The item is supplied on program A, the earlier-enrolled program, and program B receives none of that item.

## Consolidation (hypothetical, consolidation span of 5 days)

| Earliest permitted ship dates of the refills | Within 5 days of each other | Ship date |
|---|---|---|
| wound 1: 2026-05-10; wound 2: 2026-05-13 | Yes | both ship together on 2026-05-13 |
| wound 1: 2026-05-10; wound 2: 2026-05-20 | No | each ships on its own date |
